about.title: Who I am, in one paragraph
about.manifesto: Six-plus years building software for banking, legal, and energy — today as a Solutions Architect at Andbank. I have led complex migrations (Spring Boot 2 → 3, Tomcat across 40+ VMs), integrated legacy systems (COBOL, AS400, DB2), and designed hexagonal and microservices architectures. Outside work I ship complete AI-powered products: I use Claude, Codex, and MCP workflows daily to go from idea to production in days.

duration.yearsMonths: {years, plural, one {# year} other {# years}} and {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}

andbank-2024.summary: Backend architecture and technical management in private banking: development standards, core-systems integration, and evaluation of AI solutions.
highlights: Designed backend architecture (Java 21, Spring Boot 3) under Clean Architecture and hexagonal principles.
Led the Spring Boot 2 → 3 migration (Jakarta namespace) and Tomcat 7/8 → 9/10 across 40+ VMs.
Integrated legacy systems (COBOL, AS400, DB2) and rolled out Keycloak with MFA and per-jurisdiction rules.
Designed the new homebanking architecture (15+ components) and SonarQube analysis for 12,000+ COBOL files.
Managed vendors technically, drove build-vs-buy decisions, and controlled technical debt on OpenShift (OCP4).

elabogado-2022.summary: Full-stack development and platform modernization at Spain's leading legal marketplace.
highlights: Modernized legacy code: migrated Struts2 to React + Spring Boot.
Designed microservices and secure REST APIs.
Improved performance, maintainability, and architecture evolution.

zemsania-2021.summary: Backend microservices development for Indra projects.
highlights: Built microservices with Java and Spring Boot for distributed systems.
Designed and documented APIs with Swagger / OpenAPI.

keapps-2020.summary: Kronos project (Endesa): enterprise Java systems and Big Data solutions.
highlights: Big Data solutions with Hadoop and Cassandra over energy-consumption data.
Optimized batch processes and maintained critical systems.

ayesa-2019.summary: Kronos project (Endesa): Java development and data pipelines.
highlights: Developed and maintained enterprise Java systems (SOAP, XML).
Integrated systems and large-scale data pipelines.

projects.title: Selected projects
projects.hint: {count, plural, one {# project} other {# projects}} · AI-built

fintrackj.name: FinTrackJ
fintrackj.summary: Multi-bank personal finance SaaS. Aggregates accounts and transactions from several banks and uses the Claude API to categorize spending, detect patterns, and generate natural-language financial insights.
highlights: Multi-bank aggregation of accounts and transactions.
Automatic categorization and insights with the Claude API.
Type-safe stack with Next.js 15, Drizzle ORM, and Neon (serverless PostgreSQL).
Built from idea to production with AI-assisted development workflows.

facturai.name: AI Invoicing · VERI*FACTU
facturai.summary: Invoicing system compliant with Spain's VERI*FACTU regulation, using the Claude API to extract data from documents, generate invoices, and assist with tax obligations.
highlights: Compliant with the VERI*FACTU regulation (verifiable invoicing for the Spanish tax agency).
Document data extraction and assistance powered by the Claude API.
Invoice generation and delivery with full traceability.

headless-commerce.name: Headless eCommerce
headless-commerce.summary: Headless store built with MedusaJS as the commerce backend and Next.js on the front end, with AI features (search and recommendations) through the Vercel AI SDK.
highlights: Commerce backend with MedusaJS and a Next.js storefront.
AI-powered search and recommendations via the Vercel AI SDK.
Decoupled headless architecture, ready to scale.

portfolio.name: This portfolio
portfolio.summary: The very site you are reading: a type-safe Next.js + tRPC + Zod stack with bilingual routing, an interactive terminal, a command palette, and a PDF CV generated from the same data you see on screen.
highlights: Type-safe Next.js + tRPC + Zod stack with bilingual routing.
Interactive terminal and ⌘K command palette for navigation.
Server-generated PDF CV from a single source of truth.
Purposeful motion that never blocks content or shifts layout.
